name: Relay.app

hlido_opinion.headline: Solid AI agent platform with a clear focus — effective for users seeking streamlined automation but lacks extensive integration options.
hlido_opinion.body: Relay.app presents itself as an efficient AI agent platform aimed at simplifying automation tasks. Its user interface is straightforward, making it accessible for users looking to streamline workflows without heavy lifting. However, while it performs well in its niche, it does not offer extensive integration options that some competitors provide. This could limit its appeal for users with complex needs or those looking to incorporate Relay.app into a broader tech stack. The current tier is justified by its reliable performance and clear value proposition, but it may not be the best fit for users requiring deep integrations or advanced customization. Overall, Relay.app is a dependable choice for users focused on basic automation tasks.

tier_rationale: STEADY (78) reflects Relay.app's consistent performance and user-friendly design. It remains competitive in its niche but lacks the extensive integrations that could elevate it to VITAL status. Enhancements in integration capabilities could shift it to a higher tier.
